units.source_text: “官吏当中雌河童较少可能是其中一个原因。

en.t: One possible reason is that there are relatively few female kappa among the officials.

units.source_text: 相比较来说，雌河童比雄河童的嫉妒心要更强。

en.t: By comparison, female kappa are more jealous than male kappa.

units.source_text: 一旦雌河童的官吏增加了，雄河童被追逐的情况必然会减少。

en.t: Once the number of female kappa officials increases, cases of male kappa being pursued will inevitably decrease.

units.source_text: 不过效果也是非常有限的。

en.t: However, the effect is also very limited.

units.source_text: 这是因为即使是在官吏里面也是雌河童追逐雄河童的缘故。”

en.t: This is because even among officials, female kappa pursue male kappa.
